title: Skyline Outlaws: Jet Chase
shortDescription: Drive, drift, transform into a jet-powered flying car, and outrun police interceptors across a neon 3D metropolis.
description: Take the wheel of an experimental jet-powered sports car in a stylized 3D cyber-sunset city. Hit mega-ramps, deploy retractable aero-wings to fly between skyscrapers and glowing sky rings, chain high-altitude stunt combos, and evade multi-heat police pursuits to set new records and upgrade your garage.
controls: Desktop: W/S or Up/Down to accelerate/brake (or pitch climb/dive in Flight Mode), A/D or Left/Right to steer/bank, F or Tab to transform between Drive and Jet Flight Mode, Space to drift (air brake in Flight Mode), Shift/E to boost, G for Garage, C for Challenges, P to pause, R to restart.
Mobile: Left virtual thumbstick to steer and pitch/accelerate, plus dedicated on-screen touch buttons for Flight Mode, Boost, Drift/Air Brake, Gas, and Brake.
saveNote: High score, credits, unlocked vehicles, paint liveries, performance upgrades, and audio mute preference are saved locally under pg:skyline-outlaws:save.
coverAlt: A turquoise sports car facing an orange stunt ramp and glowing sky rings between low-poly skyscrapers in a bright daytime city.
